screens.title: 1 · Lista: the delivery leads
screens.why: The delivery is the title, its tasks are lines under it; Agora, Ainda hoje, and the list stops at the day.

pins.label: Delivery as title
pins.text: Consecutive tasks of one delivery are one card: its name in bodyStrong with the stack icon, the run's hours on the right. No more AppTag per task.

pins.label: Task lines
pins.text: Each task a quiet line: ✓ struck when done today, accent dot while running, ring while waiting; its hour (or length when done) on the right.

pins.label: One bar, in pieces
pins.text: Agora ends in one bar made of one piece per task, as long as its minutes, 3 px apart: done full, running as far as it got, the rest empty. Controls act on the running task.

pins.label: Ainda hoje
pins.text: Fazer em breve becomes Ainda hoje: only today's hours. Same words as the calendar's headings.

pins.label: Loose tasks stay
pins.text: A task with no delivery keeps its own card, as today.

screens.title: 2 · Lista after the day: Amanhã
screens.why: Once the working day is over, the list shows tomorrow; everything further is one line away.

pins.label: Agora, day over
pins.text: Agora is always the first stage; outside the working day it is DayOverTile, as on the calendar.

pins.label: Amanhã
pins.text: With the day over (or nothing left in it), the stage is Amanhã: tomorrow's hours only.

pins.label: The list stops
pins.text: Tasks queued past that day are not drawn: 'Mais 4 tarefas adiante' and 'Ver no calendário', which switches mode.

pins.label: Para depois
pins.text: Depois eu priorizo is renamed Para depois. Backlog tasks of one delivery group too, headed with '2 tarefas · 2h30'.

screens.title: 3 · Calendário: same card, to scale
screens.why: Agora stays on top of everything; below it a delivery's run is one block as tall as its time.

pins.label: Agora on top
pins.text: The same Agora card as Lista: one surface, identical in both modes.

pins.label: Run as one block
pins.text: Escrever, Gravar, Editar: one block 13:00–15:00. Its lines share the height by their minutes, so a long task reads long.

pins.label: Unchanged
pins.text: Free stretches, routines and fixed blocks are drawn as today.

screens.title: 4 · A routine with a list
screens.why: A routine's day can be a block with a checklist, drawn by the same card.

pins.label: Café da manhã
pins.text: A routine with items is the same card in the routine's fill, with the repeat mark. Needs a routine checklist in the model: second phase (see open questions).

pins.label: Lines by length
pins.text: Interpretar (60 min) and Escrever (55) split the block's height.

screens.title: 5 · Entregas by when they end
screens.why: No goals; deliveries headed by due day, each with two bars that should end together.

pins.label: Metas hidden
pins.text: ArtifactsPage(showGoals: false) by default: the goal cards and Nova meta are not drawn. Routes, model and agent verbs untouched.

pins.label: Due headings
pins.text: Hoje (today or late), Amanhã, Nos próximos 7 dias, Mais adiante, Sem prazo. Sorted by deadline; the queue's order breaks ties. The drag to reorder goes away.

pins.label: Feito
pins.text: Share of tasks done (or minutes, with no tasks), accent.

pins.label: Prazo
pins.text: Share of the time from created to the end of the deadline day. Same length as Feito, so they compare. Grey on pace; warning when 15 points ahead of the work; danger once late.

pins.label: In words
pins.text: 'no ritmo' or 'atrás do ritmo' (warning) closes the subtitle, so colour is not the only signal.

pins.label: The example
pins.text: Júlia: 5 of 10 done, about half of her time gone: bars end together, on pace.
